resources.string: "Choose audio and captions or translation, then Start. Android may ask for audio access or screen-sharing consent."
"Use the bubble settings for appearance and language controls. The notification can pause, recover or stop captions."
"Some apps block device-audio capture. Microphone listens to nearby sound instead."
"Changes Hearth’s interface only. Speech and translation languages stay as you chose them."
"Draw around one bubble. Vertical/horizontal Japanese and furigana · Experimental · Apache-2.0"
"Japanese line detection and recognition. Vertical reader is beta · Experimental · LGPL-3.0 model weights"
"Downloads and installs automatically. The original stays in your download folder. Multilingual streaming captions; translation uses a separate model."
"Downloads and installs automatically. The original stays in your download folder. Multilingual captions in short segments. Runtime package: March 2026."
"Compatible prepared packages are accepted. No verified ready-made 1.7B download is available. Raw checkpoints cannot be imported; use 0.6B unless preparing a compatible sherpa export."
"Downloads and installs automatically; originals stay in your folder. English, short segments. Package: 27 February 2026. This adapter is not Moonshine’s newer streaming runtime."

"Download a whisper.cpp GGML .bin file, then Import Whisper file. Tiny/Base use less memory. .en.bin models are English-only; multilingual models allow a spoken language. Safetensors and GGUF are not accepted by this adapter."
"Choose the spoken language on the publisher page. Download and extract its ZIP, then import the extracted Vosk model folder. Each model fixes the language; there is no automatic language switching."

"Legacy English → Arabic. Import a folder containing source.spm, tokenizer.json, encoder_model.onnx and decoder_model_merged.onnx from the ONNX conversion. Not GGUF or a speech ZIP. Other ONNX variants are unverified; new speech engines use the translators above."
